lookup_element_by_symbol: use ATOMIC_NUMBER to look up an element's atomic number from its chemical symbol like H or Fe
lookup_symbol_by_number: use ATOMIC_SYMBOL to look up an element's chemical symbol from its atomic number like 6 or 26
lookup_atomic_weight: use ATOMIC_WEIGHT array indexed by atomic number to get an element's atomic weight as a float
iterate_periodic_table: iterate over PERIODIC_TABLE sequence to access all 119 Element dataclass instances including Unknown
create_element_instance: create an Element dataclass instance with name, number, symbol, and weight keyword arguments
